t: A grade 5 to 8 lesson on how machine learning supports citizen science with iNaturalist.
steps: Find the Training Machines Together lesson on the National Geographic education site.
Read the lesson page and the infographic.
Check that each group has an internet-enabled device.
Share the infographic with the class.
Ask students to describe machine learning in their own words.
Assign small groups a machine learning example in citizen science.
Give students time to design a project and make an infographic.
